FIELDS.NAME: Reliable Heat Solutions
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Inspection Coordinator, Reliable Heat Solutions, john.smith@reliableheat.com, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Reliable Heat Solutions specializes in the installation and repair of residential heating systems, including boilers and furnaces, with a strong focus on safety and compliance with local building codes. Our operations include comprehensive maintenance contracts for both residential and light commercial clients, ensuring that heating systems operate efficiently and reliably. All our technicians are OSHA-certified, ensuring adherence to safety regulations and industry best practices. We utilize manufacturer-approved parts and engage in seasonal hiring of additional trained staff to manage peak demand effectively while maintaining high-quality service standards. Regular internal audits and documentation of safety procedures are conducted to support proactive risk management, ensuring a seamless and safe experience for our customers.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Reliable HVAC Services, Inc. - Specializing in HVAC maintenance and repair.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 06/15/2023; Cause: Water damage from a leaky boiler during repairs; Amount: $1,500; Status: Resolved with insurance claim processed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM; Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Fencing and patrol service during after-hours to enhance site security and protect equipment.
FIELDS.personal property valuation type: Replacement cost, actual cost value for residential heating systems.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Reliable Heat Solutions does not involve any operations related to storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. Our focus is solely on the installation and repair of residential heating systems without exposure to hazardous materials.

FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The project manager is responsible for checking the certificates to ensure compliance with safety and insurance standards.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Reliable Heat Solutions has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. All insurance policies have remained active and in good standing.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Reliable Heat Solutions does not lease employees to or from other employers; our team is comprised solely of our own employees.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Reliable Heat Solutions carries Workers’ Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and protect our employees in case of work-related injuries. All policies are active and in good standing.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Reliable Heat Solutions also operates Reliable HVAC Services, Inc., which specializes in HVAC maintenance and repair. Both businesses focus on providing quality service in the heating industry.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Reliable Heat Solutions does not have any other insurance policies with this company at the moment. All operations are covered under the existing policy outlined.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Reliable Heat Solutions is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on the installation and repair of residential heating systems.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Reliable Heat Solutions does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus is solely on the installation and repair of heating systems for our clients.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Reliable Heat Solutions has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years. The financial status remains stable and compliant with all regulations.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Reliable Heat Solutions does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals in our operations, as we focus solely on the installation and repair of residential heating systems.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Reliable Heat Solutions has no exposure to catastrophes, as we specialize in residential heating system installation and repair without involvement in high-risk environments or activities.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Reliable Heat Solutions has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain a strong focus on compliance and risk management within our operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Reliable Heat Solutions confirms that there are no uncorrected fire code violations. Our operations strictly adhere to safety regulations and local building codes.
